summary: Independent blind screening audit of main.tex and references.bib for arXiv (stat.ME / stat.AP / cs.LG) and Preprints.org passed with zero blockers and zero warnings. The pdflatex compatibility preamble (iftex/inputenc/fontenc), complete back-matter sections (Author Contributions, Funding, Institutional Review Board and Informed Consent Statement, Data and Code Availability at https://github.com/deesatzed/imboreceipt and credo_reproducibility_code.zip, Acknowledgments, and Conflicts of Interest), AI workflow disclosure, citation integrity, and numerical consistency across all 19 datasets are fully verified.
